name: methylthioadenosine phosphorylase

function.text: MTAP encodes s-methyl-5'-thioadenosine phosphorylase. Annotated molecular activities include 1,4-alpha-oligoglucan phosphorylase activity and S-methyl-5-thioadenosine phosphorylase activity. It participates in L-methionine cycle and nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to diaphyseal medullary stenosis-bone malignancy syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mesothelioma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
